copy.description: macOS private-file copies and joining use 64 KiB batches; other platforms keep std::io::copy.

retained-copy-trial.description: Warm-up trial retaining extra private TS copies; included to preserve the complete batch.

experiments.interpretation: Three variants rotated through every order position. Copy-only wall time was lower in each matched group. The retained-copy warm-up trial was not adopted; all nine rows are retained. Host load and filesystem cache were uncontrolled.

copy.description: macOS private-file copies and joining use 64 KiB batches; other platforms keep std::io::copy.

completion-driven.description: Read-only native admission during acquisition, dispatched by actual rendition completion.

experiments.interpretation: Every candidate wall time was lower than every baseline in this batch. Host load was high and baseline one-minute load was higher in every pair, so the observed reduction is confounded by unequal host load and does not establish an isolated or guaranteed speedup.

copy.description: macOS private-file copies and joining use 64 KiB batches; other platforms keep std::io::copy.

fixed-window-trial.description: Read-only warm-up trial with a fixed lookahead window; observed ranges overlap.

superseded_intermediate_experiments.interpretation: Superseded intermediate: observed wall-time ranges overlap and one pair regressed. The lower median is not evidence of a stable improvement. All six rows are retained.

live_network_references.interpretation: Single real remote-URL observations at different times and uncontrolled network/cache/host load. No causal speed comparison or percentage is calculated.

evidence_limits: One Darwin arm64 host; three matched groups per experiment; filesystem cache and other host work were uncontrolled.

Final completion-driven experiment baseline one-minute loads were 23.35, 20.04 and 41.33; candidate loads were 14.93, 13.89 and 29.77 on a ten-core host. Unequal host load confounds the wall-time result.
Separate experiment batches have different host-load conditions. Their reductions must not be added or compounded, and this is not a direct published-1.2.0-to-1.3 comparison.
RSS is a partial process-table sample keyed by parent PID without process-generation proof. Parent and descendant peaks are separate and cannot be added as a simultaneous total.
Selected workspace checkpoints are incomplete and do not cover all live files. No memory, disk-space or physical-I/O reduction is claimed.

Every run passed native media/configuration/clock comparison, native manifest checks and requested DRM checks; fresh independent verify passed afterward. No decoding or device/license-server playback was qualified.
Encryption remains per output and Packager calls remain fifteen. Different output ciphertext is not a failed media comparison.
Recorded source/build identities are those actually measured; subsequent test-only or documentation-only commits do not relabel these measurements.
